title: Recap: kell + Infinitive With an Ending

sections.title: Impersonal and Personal Obligation with kell
sections.content: You know *kell* + infinitive from A1 Unit 24 and the infinitive with personal endings from A2 Unit 41: the ending shows who has to act (*tennem kell*, *tenned kell*, *tennie kell*, *tennünk kell*). Here you use them for what people have to do for the environment: *Sokat kell tennünk a környezetvédelemért.*

items.english: We have to do a lot for environmental protection.

items.spanish: A gyáraknak csökkenteniük kell a károsanyag-kibocsátást.
items.english: Factories must reduce their harmful emissions.
